claim: *Weekly Commit Volume.* Commits per week across the project history. Bar height measures repository activity, not engineering productivity; interpreting the hardening interval requires classifying the work represented by those commits.
topology: Quantitative axes preserve source values and categories.
bw_encoding: Explicit labels, distinct markers and monochrome patterns; no color-only distinction.
redesign: Recovers the19 actual bars and quartiles from originalSVG; its description says20weeks but the artwork contains19. Candidate preserves the artwork window; does not manufacture the missing week. Restored external units and interpretive annotations at 10 pt.
questions: Original SVG contains 19 bars despite 20-week description. Confirm whether publisher edition should refresh to 20-week or 29-week evidence; current candidate preserves 19 bars.
alt: Weekly Commit Volume. Commits per week across the project history. Bar height measures repository activity, not engineering productivity; interpreting the hardening interval requires classifying the work represented by those commits.
